Interest is signalled in a register designed so that it can be withdrawn without either party having to acknowledge a refusal. That design has a purpose, and it is not cruelty: vagueness protects the person who might be rejected and the person who has to reject.
boundaryConditions: The flirting evidence is a scoping review plus a fifty-seven-person qualitative sample; over-reading and under-reading are described patterns rather than measured rates.
commonMisreadings: Autistic daters miss flirting because they are not paying close enough attention.

sourceLinks.label: Minnell, Bowden, Barbaro, Sainsbury, Gardiner & Waddington (2025), “Autistic Adults’ Relationship Perceptions and Preferences: A Scoping Review,” Autism in Adulthood
Sala, Hooley & Stokes (2020), “Romantic Intimacy in Autism: A Qualitative Analysis,” Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders

entries.title: The Room Is a Variable, and Often Yours to Set
entries.synopsis: The default first date in most of the West is a loud bar with variable lighting, unpredictable proximity to strangers, and a soundscape engineered to make conversation slightly difficult. For a substantial share of autistic adults, what that venue actually measures is auditory filtering under load — a result it then reports back as though it were a verdict on chemistry.
aliases: Room Is a Variable, and Often Yours to Set
boundaryConditions: The sensory evidence is qualitative, drawn from public narratives and open-ended survey answers, and the online-dating map rests on eight small-sample studies.
commonMisreadings: Asking to move a date somewhere quieter signals low interest, so the room has to be endured.

sourceLinks.label: Gray, Kirby & Graham Holmes (2021), “Autistic Narratives of Sensory Features, Sexuality, and Relationships,” Autism in Adulthood
Neumann, Steiner-Hofbauer & Mittmann (2024), “Autism and Online Dating: A Scoping Review,” Review Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders

entries.title: Telling Them, and the Risk Nobody Warns You About
entries.synopsis: Disclosure gets discussed as though it were a question about you: are you ready, are you comfortable, have you accepted yourself. The evidence points somewhere less flattering to everyone else. Whether disclosure helps depends substantially on what the other person already knows.
boundaryConditions: The only disclosure-outcome figure with a denominator describes workplaces rather than dating, and the victimisation comparison is a single cross-sectional study.
commonMisreadings: There is a correct moment to disclose an autism diagnosis, and mistiming it is what goes wrong.

sourceLinks.label: Sasson & Morrison (2019), “First impressions of adults with autism improve with diagnostic disclosure and increased autism knowledge of peers,” Autism 23(1):50–59
Romualdez, Heasman, Walker, Davies & Remington (2021), “‘People Might Understand Me Better’: Diagnostic Disclosure Experiences of Autistic Individuals in the Workplace,” Autism in Adulthood
Brown-Lavoie, Viecili & Weiss (2014), “Sexual Knowledge and Victimization in Adults with Autism Spectrum Disorders,” Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders 44(9):2185–2196

entries.title: SMV Calculator
entries.synopsis: A structured assessment of Looks, Money, Status, Charm, and Exposure. This is not a moral score. It is a market-position read: what creates attention, leverage, and realistic options.
boundaryConditions: The output is a structured self-assessment under LE's stated model, not an objective rank, diagnosis, or promise of response.
commonMisreadings: A calculator estimate should not be treated as more precise or universal than its self-reported inputs.
pressureTests: How does the result change when market, context, evidence quality, or evaluator assumptions change?

entries.title: Compatibility Calculator
entries.synopsis: Score any of the four Love Hierarchies, factor by factor. The headline shows the full weighted score and its band — nothing is capped. The framework line beneath it names any structural breach the profile trips — a sub-5 metric, a failed 7–7 Rule, an uncleared gate — so a high number can’t quietly hide a tanked core factor.
boundaryConditions: The tool can organize known information and flag mismatches; it cannot establish live chemistry or future durability.
commonMisreadings: A high compatibility score means two people will pair, so the number predicts dating outcomes.
pressureTests: Which high-scoring pair fails in person, and which unmeasured factor explains the miss?

entries.title: Face Calculator
entries.synopsis: Drop in a face — on your device, nothing uploaded — and it reads everything it can from the photo, then scores it on one scale: a percentile of a stated reference population, 5.5 being its median. No sliders. It pairs with the Body Calc, and the two combine into an Overall looks rating below.
boundaryConditions: Image-derived proportions are sensitive to pose, lens, lighting, landmark placement, and the model's limited construct.
commonMisreadings: Facial measurements are not a full judgment of attractiveness, health, identity, or worth.

entries.title: Body Calculator
entries.synopsis: Drop in a full-body photo — on your device, nothing uploaded — and it reads the frame it can from the silhouette, then scores it on one scale: a percentile of a stated reference population, 5.5 being its median. No sliders. It pairs with the Face Calc, and the two combine into an Overall looks rating below.
boundaryConditions: Body estimates depend on self-report and simplified proportions; they are not medical or diagnostic outputs.
commonMisreadings: A model category is not a universal attractiveness verdict or health assessment.

entries.title: Matchmaker
entries.synopsis: Not a flattering list — the realistic intersection. It takes your own value profile (pulled from your SMV, Face and Body calcs), asks what you want, then finds the celebrities you'd actually match with at your level — and gives each one a full Love Hierarchy breakdown: every factor scored, every factor explained. Flip By Looks / By SMV to change which scale it pairs you on.
boundaryConditions: The instrument compares declared profiles and constraints; every suggested match remains subject to reciprocity and live interaction.
commonMisreadings: Algorithmic compatibility does not create consent, attraction, or an obligation to meet.
pressureTests: Which suggested match fails after reciprocal choice and the Interaction Gate are applied?
